reviews.title: Installed on P620
reviews.comment: DIY on P620 Threadripper Super Happy. Temps dropped from 75 -80 range to 35-40 . Had to put hack saw to desktop body. Very pleased with the result.
reviews.author: Kanwar S Singh

reviews.title: Great cooling solution, loud af
reviews.comment: Great price/performance for my 9955wx +ai top trx50. easy to install and improved cooling over the arctic freezer 4um I had previously by 4-5 degrees. The hoses aren't slanted off the CPU so check if your board is supported first on Arctic's website. Only downside I've found is these fans are LOUD. Thankfully, unlike the air cooler (not as loud as the aio), you can swap fans as desired.
reviews.author: Robaji

reviews.title: Amazing Cooler for this price. and no RGB is a plus.
reviews.comment: Absolute beast, Threadripper 7970x 32c/64T, 350W, full load, temps below 80C. For this price this is a amazing value proposition, at least for low/mid core count CPU, probably for 64c/128t CPU or TPU 500W (or PBO for 7970x), temps will elevate, but without PBO, this is super silent, super high quality and finally no RGB BS cooler, which looks professional and it is efficient and silent.
reviews.author: Dariusz
